descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-17 Post-Round Review & Completion · S11 Ask on Post-Round, Hospital: 'Summarize the encounter' uses only this patient's stored data

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T10 Ask from Post-Round (TFA-92593): 'Ask About the Encounter or Patient' opens from Post-Round in both contexts, and its answers use only this patient's stored data: the saved note as last edited, nothi … (TFA-92593 AC 2; TFA-92593 AC 3; TFA-92593 AC 6; TFA-92593 AC 9; UAT 3.4; UAT TC-17)
  • U14 AI check on scenarios, not single passes (3.2), if it applies to Post-Round Ask (Q8): the Ask set runs on at least 10 independent fixtures (5 Hospital, 5 Nursing Home), passes at 9/10 or better, and … (UAT 3.2)

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Hospital patient with a generated note, encounter notes, transcript, tracker rows and one open task

When Ask the Post-Round preset 'Summarize the encounter' (no live transcript, no unsaved draft: as the Post-Round sheet sends it)

Then The summary names the cough, ceftriaxone, the held lisinopril and the BMP, and nothing that is not stored

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): mustInclude stored facts; mustNotInclude likely inventions for CAP and the 3.4 phrases ('ICU' replaced by phrases that cannot sit inside ordinary words such as 'difficulty' or 'circulation'). The model is recorded per run (3.9). One of the ten in aiCheck group TC-17-ask (U14, RG-POOL)

Where it ran: dev unit U46; test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S11 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-17.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AICHECK · AI output check; secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
